seoDescription: Petrina Salema's practice in Vienna. Homes and hospitality spaces, a handful of projects a year, from the plan through materials, sourcing, and styling.
hook: People usually ask for nicer rooms. But what they are really looking for are rooms to shape how they want to live.
body: I help people set up spaces to shape how they want to live, and how they want their guests to feel. The practice started in Vienna in 2021, after years studying interior design and working in architecture studios. Most projects run one to three months, from the plan through materials, sourcing, and styling. Only a handful each year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

principles.title: If it only looks good in photos, it isn't finished.
principles.body: The room has to hold up on ordinary days, including cleaning, storage, and how people actually move.

principles.title: I take on only a few projects at a time
principles.body: Each one gets attention from the first call through to final styling.

principles.title: A place to rest that can also have people over
principles.body: Somewhere quiet to think, that will survive real use.

ctaLede: Start with a conversation. Bring the floor plan if you have one. In 30 minutes it should be clear whether a full project or a paid hour is the right next step.
